purpose: Lightweight macro-world skeleton for 塵行 rewrite. This is the durable layer; opening fortress names are replaceable.

worldShape.rule: Known civilization lives in linked fortresses; wilderness between them is lethal without corridors.

fiveDomains.name: 中域
fiveDomains.role: Densest fortresses, highest civilization, sect politics center.

fiveDomains.name: 東域
fiveDomains.role: Coast and island fortresses; sea beasts and offshore ruins.

fiveDomains.name: 西域
fiveDomains.role: Desert mobility camps and ore economy.

fiveDomains.name: 南域
fiveDomains.role: Jungle, miasma, and survival-first moral pressure.

fiveDomains.name: 北域
fiveDomains.role: Frozen ruins, ancient relics, few but hardened fortresses.

corridorSystem.rule: Trade, migration, and military movement depend on maintained corridors.

displacedPersonLore.storyLink: 陸塵行 may be classified under this pattern without the world understanding why.

openingStagePolicy.rule: Opening location is rewriteable. Macro skeleton and cultivation system are not.

rewritePriorities: Keep 陸塵行, 愛醬, and 塵行 title.
Keep cultivation system v1 unless author explicitly revises.
Keep fortress-island world shape and five-domain map.
Replace or rename opening fortress freely.
Rebuild plot from living-world pressure, not from draft scene inventory.
